messages:
claire: Quick heads-up — rolling out the new Hosted streaming + tool-call runtime starting today in eu-west-1 and us-central-1. This rollout includes: streaming V3, improved chunked responses, and a single tool-calling surface (calls are now handled server-side and forwarded to configured connectors). Docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/streaming-v3 :ship: 

samir: Nice — does this change rate limits or per-request billing?

claire: Good question. Unit billing stays per-token, but streaming uses an updated chunking heuristic which reduces billed tokens for common short-turn workloads. We are also introducing a per-connection concurrency cap default (50 concurrent streams) to protect latency SLOs. You can request higher caps for Dedicated customers.

ops-jen: Monitoring + SLOs are enabled for the rollout. We'll canary at 1% traffic for first 2h, 10% for next 6h, then full. Alerting on p95 RTT regression + error spike. Pager rules unchanged. :rotating_light:

matt: What about orgs using the old /v2/stream endpoint? Any deprecation timeline?

claire: /v2/stream will be supported for 30 days, then disabled unless you opt-in to extended support. Migration steps are small: change endpoint to /v3/stream and add header X-Stream-Mode: chunked. Example: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
     -H "X-Stream-Mode: chunked" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v3/stream
```

lisa: FYI — client-side snippet for web sockets (Node) that maps to v3: 
```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v3/stream');
ws.send(JSON.stringify({key: process.env.KEY, model: 'rwd-llama-70b'}));
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('chunk', m));
```

samir: For Dedicated customers with private endpoints, do we need a config change?

claire: For Dedicated/private, the runtime is feature-flagged. Platform team will flip the flag in your cluster; no client changes beyond the header. If you manage your own ingress, add header passthrough for X-Stream-Mode.

deploy-bot: deploy/update v3-stream-runtime started by @claire — canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% (eu-west-1, us-central-1).

ops-jen: I'll be watching dashboards and will post any anomalies in #incidents. If you see anything odd please @ops-jen in-thread.

claire: Thanks all — internal migration doc and rollback/runbook are at the link above. We'll have a short walkthrough tomorrow at 11am PT for SDK and tool-runner changes. If you need early access to the feature flag or extended support for /v2/stream, ping me or @eng-runtime. :tada:
